items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain financial containment and reject all new dispatches, spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization changes, experiments, telemetry, deployments, and requeues this cycle. Continue only the existing period-aligned revenue, attribution, cost, measurement, legal, security, and failure-repair work. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 is not site-attributable; site-attributed commission of $0 does not prove zero site performance. AI usage covers 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27: 4,892 calls and $890.42 cost, with 225 errors and 5 transient errors. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because periods are misaligned, infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing/experiment costs are incomplete, monthly budget limits are blank, and no learning-outcome threshold is defined. The pilot's 70 treatment outputs versus 44 controls are operational activity, not financial or causal lift. Retain all product, SEO, UX, CRO, launch-readiness, and site-factory ideas as deferred backlog only; do not queue the proposed launch-readiness change request. Minimum measurement remains: period-aligned attributable revenue by site/content/tracking ID, a reconciled complete cost ledger, approved budget ceilings, and a defined learning outcome with a maximum cost-to-learn.
